{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: DC Power Supply Variable 30V 10A, KAIWEETS 4-Digit Large Display Adjustable Switching Regulated Power Supply with USB Interface; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to power and test breadboard circuits alongside my Arduino components.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Sutemribor Brass Solid Round Rod Lathe Bar Stock, 3/8 Inch in Diameter 14 Inches in Length (2 PCS); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current machining project that needs brass stock.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: CHANZON 100 pcs 5mm RGB Multicolor Fast Blinking (Multi Color Changing) Dynamics LED Diode Lights (Flashing Round DC) Bright Lighting Bulb Lamps Electronics Components Flicker Light Emitting Diodes; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Automatically flashing lights are less useful for my circuit projects than controllable indicators.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: EDGELEC 100pcs 220 ohm Resistor 1/2w (0.5Watt) ±1% Tolerance Metal Film Fixed Resistor, Multiple Values of Resistance Optional; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these for suitable LED breadboard circuits using components I already have.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Chanzon 100 pcs 3mm Green LED Diode Lights (Clear Round Transparent DC 3V 20mA) Bright Lighting Bulb Lamps Electronics Components Indicator Light Emitting Diodes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Simple indicators fit my projects, but my previous PCB kit included LEDs, so I would skip another bulk pack today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: HiLetgo 2000W PWM AC Motor Speed Control Module Dimmer Speed Regulator 50-220V Adjustable Voltage Regulator; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My component history suggests small circuit projects, and I have no present need for an AC motor controller.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: AST Labs Test Lead Kelvin Clip to 4-channel Banana Plug (3 feet); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have an identified measurement task or compatible instrument that needs these specialized leads.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: BNTECHGO 24 AWG Magnet Wire - Enameled Copper Wire - Enameled Magnet Winding Wire - 1.0 lb - 0.0197" Diameter 1 Spool Coil Red Temperature Rating 155℃ Widely Used for Transformers Inductors; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits experimenting with my ferrite cores, but I would wait until I have a specific winding project before buying a full spool.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: DC Power Supply Adjustable (30V 10A), Eventek Variable Switching Regulated Digital Power Supply with Alligator Leads US Power Cord (30V 10A); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This would also suit circuit testing, but I would only buy one supply and have already chosen the KAIWEETS option this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: MG Chemicals - 4860P-35G 4860P 63/37 No Clean, Leaded Solder Paste, 35 g (1.2 oz) Pneumatic Dispenser (Complete with Plunger & Dispensing Tip); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My breadboards and through-hole components do not give me an immediate reason to buy solder paste."}
